sources.entry: Apache Netbeans - Apache NetBeans is an IDE, Tooling Platform and Application Framework suitable for development in Java, JavaScript, PHP, HTML5, CSS, and more.

summary.one_liner: Apache NetBeans is an open source development environment, tooling platform, and application framework, built with Ant from source.
summary.what_it_does: Provides the source for the NetBeans IDE and its underlying NetBeans Platform, which is a modular application framework. The build is driven by Ant, with selectable cluster configurations (release, basic, full, platform) controlling which modules are included. The build produces a portable NetBeans zip that can be extracted and launched with a bundled launcher script that accepts options such as a custom userdir, cachedir, JDK home, and font size. The README also covers generating Javadoc, running a quick test with an Ant target, and where settings, logs, and caches are stored. Full project history is available by merging an archived repository into the modern one via git replace.
use_cases: build the NetBeans IDE from source
develop Java applications in an IDE
build a modular desktop application on the NetBeans Platform
run a portable NetBeans installation with custom settings directories
explore history of NetBeans code before Apache donation
how_to_run: git clone the repository and cd into it
Requires Git, Ant, and JDK 21 or above
extract the zip from nbbuild and run netbeans/bin/netbeans --userdir /tmp/nbtestdir1
notable: Multiple build cluster configurations (release, basic, full, platform) selected via cluster.config
Portable zip distribution with a launcher supporting userdir, cachedir, and jdkhome options
Full git history restorable by merging an archived repository using git replace
Modules can be opened individually in NetBeans and run or debugged like normal projects
caveats: Building requires JDK 21 or above plus Ant and Git installed
Full project build may take substantial time and includes clusters not in the release
Full history retrieval requires fetching a large archive repository, which the README says takes a while
